sql: select market_ticker, side, action, limit_price, quantity, status, cancel_reason, created_at::text, (select max(started_at)::text from incentive_discovery_cycles) disc from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-10-10 18:15' or status in ('resting','partial','pending','submitted','unknown')) order by created_at desc limit 20
